units.summary: statusRecorder gains an onStatus callback field used to report the breaker outcome as soon as the status is written. It is set only by serveThroughBreaker.
units.headline: statusRecorder gets an onStatus callback hook
units.reason: New field carries the breaker-reporting hook that changes when outcomes are recorded; reviewed together with WriteHeader and serveThroughBreaker.
focus: that onStatus is only set where the once-guard in serveThroughBreaker applies

units.summary: WriteHeader now invokes onStatus with the final status (non-1xx, or 101) before forwarding to the underlying writer. This is what lets the breaker learn the outcome when a watch starts rather than when it ends.
units.headline: WriteHeader reports final status to breaker callback
units.reason: Runs a callback in the response path, changing when breaker outcomes are recorded.
focus: the callback runs before the underlying WriteHeader and must not block
proxy failure is recorded before the 502 status is written by the error handler

units.summary: Introduces a type alias for gobreaker's two-step circuit breaker, replacing the one-step type across the router.
units.headline: Add groupBreaker alias for the two-step breaker
units.reason: A type alias only; behavior change lives in newGroupBreaker and serveThroughBreaker.

units.summary: Group breakers are now created as two-step breakers with the same settings, so callers must use Allow and report an outcome. Every consumer of the breaker (router, ST fallback) is affected.
units.headline: Group breakers now constructed as two-step breakers
units.reason: Changes the breaker's calling contract and thus how all proxied requests are counted.
focus: every user of the breaker (including the ST fallback) goes through serveThroughBreaker and reports exactly one outcome

units.summary: Replaces cb.Execute with Allow plus a once-guarded done callback, reported on status write, on return, or on panic. A half-open breaker's trial slot is freed when a watch's status is known instead of when it ends, and a re-panic is preserved.
units.headline: Breaker outcome reported at status write, not handler return
units.reason: Concurrency, panic handling and breaker accounting changed on the main proxy path.
focus: exactly one outcome is reported on every path, including panic and no-WriteHeader returns
failures after a 200 status (mid-stream errors) are no longer counted against the backend
outcome computed in onStatus sees the proxy failure recorded before the status is written
panic with a nil outcome is reported as a failure and re-panicked unchanged

units.summary: Test helper signature updated to the groupBreaker alias.
units.headline: Test helper takes groupBreaker type

units.summary: Test now builds a two-step breaker to match the production type; assertions are unchanged.
units.headline: Half-open cap test uses two-step breaker
units.reason: Test-only constructor change with unchanged expectations.

units.summary: Helper trips the breaker through Allow and done with a forced failure instead of Execute.
units.headline: tripBreaker uses Allow/done instead of Execute
units.reason: Test helper adapted to the two-step API with the same effect.
